subject: general
question: What was the score for Goal 1 (No Poverty) in the 2023-24 SDG India Index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**72**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The score for Goal 1 (No Poverty) in the 2023-24 SDG India Index was 72**.
 
• This was **an improvement from 60 in the 2020-21 index.** 
 
• The SDG India Index is a report that measures India's progress towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• The **index is compiled by NITI Aayog.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The index scores states and union territories (UTs) on a scale of 0 to 100 for each indicator.
 
• The overall score for each state or UT is the sum of the scores for all 17 SDGs.
 
• The index categorizes states and UTs into four groups based on their scores: Achievers, Front-Runners, Performers, and Aspirants.
